observations: Named public-place records matching scheduled venues were accepted; the Hanoi pickup uses an address-matched public record and Khe Cải uses exact coordinates and a Maps link supplied by the user. Search camera centers and unnamed multi-result lists were rejected.
Photon results outside the trip area were rejected.
The homestay named record also links facebook.com/muatrutaxua, matching the existing directory.
The user confirmed the Khe Cải and Tập đoàn Viettel coordinates and Maps links on 16 October 2026.
The afternoon group has no agreed internal order.
The town coordinate is only an approximate area reference for the unassigned town lunch.
Google public embed records were used at research time only; there is no runtime Google Maps dependency.
On 22 October 2026, the user replaced the Viettel pickup with 68 Mạc Thái Tông and changed gathering to 21:00; departure remains 22:00. The named Google Maps embed record matched this exact address.
